messages:
Anita: heads-up — saw one eval-harness run balloon CPU on a subset of workers, looks like "shuffle" step holding tasks alive
Ravi: which run? thread_ts?
Anita: 1764442222, nightly-quant-onboard-04
Tom: logs? any stacktraces?
Anita: paste logs —
```
2025-06-12T01:03:05Z runner[shard=12]: assign shuffle -> worker=w-23 lease=uuid-abc
2025-06-12T01:03:05Z runner[shard=12]: dispatch batch id=987 size=120
2025-06-12T01:04:45Z worker[w-23]: heartbeat lost to broker, reconnecting
2025-06-12T01:05:10Z runner[shard=12]: shuffle timeout, marking pending but NOT releasing lease
```
Sylvie: that "NOT releasing lease" line is suspicious — I think the lease cleanup path didn't run if reconnect happened during shuffle
Tom: could be a race between batch ack and lease release. we've seen similar but not with this shuffle path
Ravi: queue length on that shard? metrics show 20k backlog for a minute
Anita: yep — eyeballing datadog: eval.runner.queue.depth{shard=12} spike -> 20k then slow drain
DatadogBot: [alert] eval.runner.queue.depth high on shard=12 — 2025-06-12 01:06 UTC
CI Bot: eval-harness/nightly-quant-onboard-04 FAILED (timeout) — see artifacts: https://ci.internal/runs/2389
Tom: quick mitigation: can we force lease revocation script to run across workers? `./tools/revoke_leases --shard 12 --force`
Ravi: careful — that can cause double-processing if task still running. but we need to unblock test queue
Sylvie: proposed fix: in shuffle worker handler add finally block to always call release_lease() and add idempotent lease-check before requeue
Anita: I can whip up a tiny patch and run it on canary
Tom: also add extra logging around ack path: `if not acked: log lease_owner, task_id`
Anita: patch pushed to PR #8342 (wip) — runs on canary now
CI Bot: canary deployment started for infra/team=eval-harness, rollout=canary-5
Ravi: also suggest a short-term circuit: cap max inflight batches per worker for shuffle to 8
Sylvie: good idea, that would reduce blast radius while we fix cleanup
Anita: canary run shows no backlog for 30m so far, worker CPU stable
Tom: once PR lands, add unit test simulating heartbeat drop during shuffle and verify lease release
Ravi: make sure to bump canary config in ci to run the simulated-race test
Anita: noted. I'll open follow-up task to add dashboard panel: "shuffle inflight by worker" and alert if > 50
DatadogBot: incident resolved: queue depth back to normal for shard=12
Sylvie: post-mortem notes: root cause = missing finally on lease release in shuffle path + no cap on inflight; remediation = patch + inflight caps + new race test + dashboard
Tom: thanks — can we close the CI incident after PR merges and a 24h stable window?
Ravi: yes, will monitor. :thumbsup:
Anita: thanks team, tracking in TICKET-4621
CI Bot: build passed for PR #8342 — merging
Anita: merged and deployed to prod. Monitoring for 24h.
